metadata.purpose: Quick lookup reference for action director workflow

hongkong_kung_fu.key_techniques: shuai jiao footwork, hand-speed strikes, environmental use, prop integration
hongkong_kung_fu.camera_priority: quick cuts, close-ups on contact, follow-cam on combos
hongkong_kung_fu.audio_priority: impacts distinct, speed emphasis, environmental sounds

brazilian_jitsu.key_techniques: leverage emphasis, grip strength, positional control, breathing visibility
brazilian_jitsu.camera_priority: locked wide or extreme close-up, minimal motion
brazilian_jitsu.audio_priority: breathing, mat friction, silence as tool

boxing.key_techniques: footwork, guard integrity, head movement, torso targeting
boxing.camera_priority: profile angles, head-height camera, hand-speed tracking
boxing.audio_priority: glove contact distinct, breathing effort, ring acoustics

muay_thai.key_techniques: clinch work, eight-point strikes, knee/elbow emphasis, rotational power
muay_thai.camera_priority: clinch-close framing, rotational tracking, leg emphasis
muay_thai.audio_priority: clinch sound details, strikes layered (kick/knee/elbow distinct)

sword_fighting.key_techniques: point clarity, footwork spacing, blade interaction, line geometry
sword_fighting.audio_priority: blade clash ringing, whoosh sounds, impact resonance

kickboxing.key_techniques: leg-heavy strikes, stance rotation, balance emphasis, power visible
kickboxing.camera_priority: full-body emphasis to show leg extension, rotation tracking
kickboxing.audio_priority: kick impact distinct, body strikes layered

professional_wrestling.key_techniques: carry dynamics, height differential, staged impact, partner coordination
professional_wrestling.camera_priority: full-body to show carry, theatrical framing, crowd-facing
professional_wrestling.audio_priority: body contact variety, crowd reaction, dramatic underscore

sofia_coppola.camera_motion: very slow push-in (5+ seconds for 2m) or static
sofia_coppola.audio_approach: minimal music, breathing emphasis, silence as tool

park_chan_wook.camera_motion: slow lateral tracking, rotational pans, geometric
park_chan_wook.cutting_style: composed shots, longer holds for composition

denis_villeneuve.camera_motion: slow push-in, very wide shots, landscape emphasis
denis_villeneuve.cutting_style: patient setup, fast exchange, slow recovery

chloe_zhao.camera_motion: minimal motion, static mostly, organic handheld
chloe_zhao.audio_approach: ambient, breathing, authentic effort sounds, silence

lynne_ramsay.audio_approach: textural layered, sensory emphasis, psychological soundscape

jane_campion.camera_motion: slow push-in, rare pans, sensory focus

motion_types: static/hold frame - completely still, no motion, forbid drift explicitly
slow push-in - camera moves toward subject at 40-60% of action speed
slow arc tracking - camera arcs around subject maintaining subject in frame center
handheld wobble - 2-4 Hz micro-motion, ±1-2 pixels, continuous
handheld reframing - deliberate pan/tilt following action, 1-2 second moves
slow lateral tracking - camera tracks side-to-side at 25-40% of action speed
dynamic handheld following - camera follows subject at 60-80% of speed
pull-back arc - camera arcs away from action, expanding frame
slow push-out - camera moves away from subject slowly (opposite of push-in)
tilting arc - camera tilts vertically following vertical movement
rotating pan - smooth rotational camera motion around subject
distance_zones: extreme close-up - faces, hands, contact points (0.3-1m)
medium wide - two full bodies with environment (8-12m)
very wide - landscape context, full scene (20m+)
angle_positions: profile - 90 degrees to subject motion (optimal for seeing strikes)
frontal - directly facing subject (good for reactions, poor for side strikes)
low angle - camera looking up (power emphasis)
high angle - camera looking down (vulnerability/defeat emphasis)
over-shoulder - one character's POV looking at other
reverse angle - opposite side from previous shot (cutting between two speakers)
z-axis diagonal - foreground vs background creating depth (optimal for composition)
focus_strategies: deep focus - f/5.6-f/8, everything sharp (establish clarity)
medium focus - f/3.5-f/5.6, main subject sharp, background slightly soft
shallow focus - f/1.4-f/2.8, main subject sharp, background very blurred (isolate subject)
rack focus - focus shifts from one plane to another during shot (revelation)
soft focus - deliberate slight blur across frame (dreamy, emotional)

high_speed_compensation_strategies.name: Slow Push-In (Kurosawa Rule)
high_speed_compensation_strategies.how: Camera slowly pushes in 1-3m over 3-6s at 40-60% of action speed
high_speed_compensation_strategies.example_prompt: slow push-in over 3 seconds from 15m to 12m, background progressively blurs

high_speed_compensation_strategies.name: Static Hold at Impact (Lee Rule)
high_speed_compensation_strategies.how: Completely static hold for 0.2-0.3s, no panning/zooming/drift
high_speed_compensation_strategies.why: Static frame = psychological 'this is important' signal
high_speed_compensation_strategies.example_prompt: camera becomes completely static for 0.3 seconds, isolating impact

high_speed_compensation_strategies.name: Arc Tracking (Chan Rule)
high_speed_compensation_strategies.how: Camera arcs at 40-60% of movement speed, fighter passes through arc
high_speed_compensation_strategies.example_prompt: arc tracking at 40% of strike speed maintaining fighter center-frame

high_speed_compensation_strategies.name: Handheld Tension (Bigelow Rule)
high_speed_compensation_strategies.example_prompt: handheld camera with continuous micro-wobble creating urgency

high_speed_compensation_strategies.name: Multiple Rapid Cuts (Editing Rule)
high_speed_compensation_strategies.how: Cut to new angle right as blur peaks, 0.3-0.5s per cut max
high_speed_compensation_strategies.why: Cut = new information = feels faster, blur hidden by transition
high_speed_compensation_strategies.example_prompt: rapid cuts every 0.4s between different angles of striking sequence

timing_budgeting_rules: Slow camera moves: 3-6s typical for 2-3m movement
Climax beat placement: Never in final 10% of total duration

diegetic: Impact sounds - hits, blocks, kicks (vary by martial art)
Environmental - water drips, wind, rain, reverb, footsteps
Body sounds - fabric rustles, joints popping, muscle tension
Object sounds - railing contact, ground impact, chair scrape
non_diegetic: Music - instrumental, beats, sustained notes, silence as primary
frequency_targeting: Blade clash: 5-8 kHz (very high, ringing resonance)

validation_checklist: Duration matches target (sum timing chart blocks)
Director style evident in pacing, framing, color choices
Static shots explicitly forbid drift (not just 'static')
All actions are observable behavior (not emotion/motivation)
Climax beat positioned before final 10% of duration
Martial art choreography authentic to selected style
All cuts and transitions timestamped to 0.1s precision
Audio design supports visual narrative (impacts clear, breathing sync)
Timing chart shown to user for verification before generation
common_mistakes_to_avoid: Vague action descriptions without timing chart (generates generic results)
Mixing multiple director styles without coherent blend (creates visual chaos)
High-speed martial art with no cinematography compensation (blurry result)
Climax beat in final 10% of clip (gets compressed, payoff lost)
Emotional language instead of observable behavior ('angry punch' vs 'fist impact chin')
Uniform camera motion throughout (boring, no visual dynamics)
Ignoring martial art pacing rules (e.g., BJJ treated like HK kung fu)
Impact moments without 0.2s minimum hold frame (force not registered)
No audio strategy (purely visual prompt misses rhythm/tension opportunities)
Cutting every 0.2s for non-Bigelow style (creates disorientation, not desired effect)

prompt_template_mini.structure:
Task type: T2VA
Duration: X seconds
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, [description]
[Shot 2] At [time]s, [description]
... [Shot N]
integrated_multimodal_description: [one paragraph synthesis]
overall_soundscape: [audio layers]
non_diegetic_music: [music treatment]
key_rules: One [Shot N] block only at true cuts (angle/distance change)
All actions as observable behavior, never emotion
Camera motion as natural prose, not technical specs
Static shots must forbid drift: 'Camera remains completely static; no pan, tilt, or drift'
Under 2000 tokens total for MiniMax H3 efficiency

sofia_coppola_kathryn_bigelow.effect: Intimate tension - contemplative close-ups with handheld urgency
sofia_coppola_kathryn_bigelow.approach: Coppola for establishing/recovery shots (2-3s, static/slow push), Bigelow for action (0.5-1.0s, handheld)

park_chan_wook_denis_villeneuve.effect: Baroque precision - saturated geometry in wide landscapes
park_chan_wook_denis_villeneuve.approach: Park for tactical close-ups (geometric, slow arc), Denis for establishing (wide, patient)
park_chan_wook_denis_villeneuve.color: Saturated with gold/red accents against blue landscape

greta_gerwig_kathryn_bigelow.effect: Playful chaos - choreographed action with handheld energy
greta_gerwig_kathryn_bigelow.approach: Gerwig for flow/choreography (composed 2-3s, slow-motion arcs), Bigelow for tension (handheld, cuts)
greta_gerwig_kathryn_bigelow.color: Saturated playful palette with quick movements
